name: CHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Colorado Springs, CO · Norris Penrose Event Center
headline: Colorado state: Niwot, Boulder and ThunderRidge meet a national-level field
summary: Defending 5A champion Niwot brings DyeStat’s No. 4 boys team and No. 7 girls team to Colorado Springs, with No. 8 Boulder and No. 9 ThunderRidge in the girls race. Northfield’s Abdi Hassan, No. 2 in DyeStat’s individual rankings, Coronado’s Oliver Horton (No. 10) and Eaton’s Delaney Reuter (No. 9 girls) are all entered. The 5A girls race starts at 1:00 p.m. MT and the 5A boys at 2:20 p.m.
